'''Zakthok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire.]] He sold items on [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />
